It’s repetitive but rewarding once mastered!

1) Find the derivative *f'(x)*—this gives the slope at any point. 2) Set *f'(x) = 0* and solve for x (critical points). 3) Check second derivative (*f''(x)*) to classify: if positive, it’s a minimum; if negative, a maximum. Stationary points reveal peaks/troughs in the function.
